episodes.title: Part 1: The Veil of Confusion
episodes.break_rationale: Deepak disembarks in his village only to uncover the horrifying truth that he brought home the wrong veiled bride; miles away, Phool awakens stranded alone at an unfamiliar railway platform.
episodes.recap_text: In rural 2001 India, newlyweds Deepak and Phool travel home on a packed night train with identical veiled brides. In the nighttime disembarkation chaos, Deepak accidentally leads the wrong bride home.
episodes.teaser_next: Deepak launches a frantic search across the district as Phool struggles to survive stranded at the remote station.

episodes.title: Part 2: Stranded in Pateela
episodes.break_rationale: Cynical Inspector Shyam Manohar suspects foul play when he finds pawned jewelry, realizing the quiet bride in Deepak's home is operating under an alias with a hidden agenda.
episodes.recap_text: At the railway station, kindly tea-stall owner Manju Maai takes Phool under her wing. Meanwhile, Deepak files a missing bride report as suspicion mounts around his veiled houseguest.
episodes.teaser_next: Missing person sketches circulate across the state as Shyam Manohar closes in on Jaya's secret past.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Sketch & The Secret
episodes.break_rationale: Shyam Manohar discovers Jaya's admission letter to Dehradun Agricultural University and prepares to arrest her, just as her abusive husband tracks her down to the police station.
episodes.recap_text: Jaya shares her dream of modern organic farming with Deepak's family. At the station, Phool learns self-reliance making snacks, but Deepak's missing posters struggle to reach her.
episodes.teaser_next: With corrupt forces and a vengeful husband closing in, Jaya faces her final chance to reclaim her freedom and reunite Deepak with Phool.

episodes.title: Part 4: The Path to Surajmukhi
episodes.break_rationale: Shyam Manohar tears up the arrest warrant to set Jaya free; Deepak finally spots Phool at the railway station for a tearful, heartwarming reunion as both brides reclaim their destiny.
episodes.recap_text: Overcoming rural prejudices and mistaken identities, Shyam Manohar protects Jaya, while Deepak and Phool reunite in an emotional station climax.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the beloved comedy-drama miniseries cut of Laapataa Ladies.
